name: Kherson Counter-Offensive

sides.name: Ukraine
sides.strength: Multiple brigades reinforced with HIMARS rocket artillery and Western armour

sides.name: Russia
sides.strength: 30,000+ on the west bank of the Dnipro
sides.casualties: Heavy materiel losses; troops withdrew across the river

summary: Ukraine telegraphed an attack on the south for months while Russia rotated reserves into Kherson Oblast. Long-range strikes by HIMARS shattered the Antonivsky Bridge and the Kakhovka dam crossings, severing Russian supply on the west bank of the Dnipro. The actual ground offensive ground forward through Russian defences across the autumn until Moscow ordered a withdrawal from Kherson city in early November.
significance: The first major Russian withdrawal from a regional capital it had claimed by annexation referendum the month before. Sergei Surovikin took the political cost. The front stabilised along the Dnipro for the year that followed. Kherson confirmed that Ukrainian operational design plus Western precision weapons could move the front.
